features.heading: What you can do with Image Compressor
features.intro: Useful output choices, clear limits, and processing on your device.

items.title: Choose a smaller image with a quality trade-off
items.description: Adjust the quality to create a WebP result. An image that is already optimized may not become smaller; inspect the result before replacing your original.

items.title: Stay in control of your source file
items.description: Processing uses this browser rather than a server-side media job. Keep the tab open, and save the result before leaving the page.

steps.heading: How to use Image Compressor
steps.intro: From your source file to a result you can save, in three steps.

items.title: Choose a local image
items.body: Select a JPG, PNG, or WebP image within the 50 MB allowance.

items.title: Adjust the quality
items.body: Choose a quality level and start processing. Lower quality can reduce detail as well as size.

items.title: Save and review
items.body: Download the WebP and compare its appearance and size with the original.

items.question: Can I save a compressed JPG instead?
items.answer: This compressor produces WebP. Use Image Converter if you need to change the resulting image to another available format.

items.question: Is my file uploaded?
items.answer: The selected media is processed locally in this browser. It is not uploaded to our servers for this tool.

items.question: What if processing fails or takes too long?
items.answer: Keep this tab open and try a shorter or smaller file when possible. Available memory and media support differ between devices and browsers. Your original file is not overwritten.

items.question: Do I need AI credits to use this tool?
items.answer: No. This browser-local tool does not spend AI credits. File allowances and browser capabilities still apply.
